event_description: A visitor opens the portfolio projects hub from a prominent call to action.
A visitor selects a call to action that navigates to the contact section.
A visitor selects a specific project preview before entering the projects hub.
A visitor uses the presentation controls to navigate directly to a portfolio section.
A visitor copies a direct contact channel without including the contact value in analytics.
A visitor submits the portfolio contact form without sending form-entered personal data to analytics.
